chunks: What I fear most for you are two things: following desires and extending hopes; as for following desires, it turns one away from the truth, and as for extending hopes, it makes one forget the Hereafter.
Know that this world has passed away rapidly, and nothing remains of it except the dregs, like the dregs of a vessel which the drinker has emptied.

Know that the Hereafter has approached, and each of them has sons (followers); so be among the sons of the Hereafter, and do not be among the sons of this world, for every son will be joined to his mother on the Day of Resurrection.
Indeed, today is a day of action and no reckoning, and tomorrow is a day of reckoning and no action.
ai.seo_question: What are the two things the Prophet fears most for his followers regarding spiritual decline?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) identifies 'following desires' (ittiba' al-hawa) and 'prolonged hope' (tulu' al-amal) as the twin roots of spiritual negligence, a classification deeply rooted in Shia ethical theology. The metaphor of the world as a discarded vessel underscores the transient nature of dunya, urging believers to actively choose allegiance to the Hereafter before the final accounting. This passage serves as a practical guide for self-assessment, emphasizing that current actions determine one's eternal lineage on the Day of Judgment.

en.sayed-ali-raza: what I fear most about you are two things — acting according to desires and extending of hopes. As regards acting according to desires, this prevents from truth; and as regards extending of hopes, it makes one forget the next world.
You should know this world is moving rapidly and nothing has remained out of it except last particles like the dregs of a vessel which has been emptied by some one.

Beware, the next world is advancing, and either of them has sons i.e. followers. You should become sons of the next world and not become sons of this world because on the Day of Judgement every son would cling to his mother.
Today is the Day of action and there is no reckoning while tomorrow is the Day of reckoning but there would be no (opportunity for) action.
